question: Which of the following institutions launched the microfinance movement in India on a pilot basis in 1992?
solution:
The correct answer is "**NABARD". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **The beginning of **the micro finance movement in India** could be traced to the selfhelp group (SHG) - bank linkage programme (SBLP) started as a pilot project in 1992 by **National Bank for Agricultural and Rural Development (NABARD).**
 
• **This programme** not only proved to be** very successful**, but has also emerged as **the most popular model of micro finance in India. **\
 
• Other approaches like micro finance institutions (MFIs) also emerged subsequently in the country.
